results.remarks: Experience contemporary loft living in the vibrant Dogtown neighborhood of West Oakland. This spacious three-bedroom, three-bath dream combines an open, airy feel with versatile living spaces and convenient access to the best of the East Bay and San Francisco. The open kitchen and living spaces create a natural gathering place for entertaining. A full bedroom and bathroom on the lower level offer excellent flexibility for guests, a home office, or additional private living space. results.remarks: Le Chateau is one of those special Oakland properties that feels magical from the moment you arrive. Its beautifully landscaped courtyard winds through mature greenery, terracotta-tiled stairs and decorative ironwork, giving the eight-unit community a wonderful old-Hollywood character. 208 Lee Street carries that character inside, with nearly 1,700 square feet spread across three levels. The main floor feels substantial and distinctly home-like, with the living and dining spaces separated from the bedrooms above. In the living room, a beautiful exposed wood-beamed ceiling, brick fireplace and large windows give the room warmth and architectural presence. Hardwood floors continue into the dining room, a space made for lingering over dinner with friends. Just beyond, the kitchen offers abundant cabinetry and stainless appliances, with a powder room conveniently nearby. Upstairs are two bedrooms and a full bath. The primary bedroom is especially spacious, with an adjoining dressing and closet area that includes a built-in desk—a charming and useful little space for getting ready, additional clothing storage or a compact work area. The second bedroom is also nicely proportioned and filled with natural light. Downstairs, the private one-car garage opens directly into a large unfinished bonus area with laundry and generous under-stair storage. It is highly useful as it stands for bikes, projects, gear and everyday overflow, while the size of the room leaves room to imagine something more finished—a media room, lounge, exercise space or other flexible use with thoughtful improvements. A covered patio just outside opens to the surrounding greenery. And Adams Point makes an especially good backdrop. Lake Merritt and Lakeside Park are nearby, along with the restaurants, cafés and shops of Grand Avenue. The Grand Lake Theatre and Saturday farmers market are close at hand, with Uptown and 19th Street BART also within easy reach. There is plenty happening nearby, while Le Chateau itself feels surprisingly tucked away. With its vintage architecture, generous proportions, private garage and stunning grounds, 208 Lee Street offers the ease of condominium ownership in a space that simply feels much more like a home.

Large bay windows frame views of the waterway, creating a striking backdrop for the open, airy living spaces. Fresh paint, new carpeting, and newly refinished hardwood floors add to the home’s bright, move-in-ready feel.  The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a gas range, abundant cabinetry, and bar-style seating, while the spacious dining area flows seamlessly into the open living room. Step outside to the private balcony and enjoy the peaceful waterfront setting. The main level features two bright and spacious bedrooms with ceiling fans and generous closets, along with a full bathroom. A large dedicated laundry room offers built-in cabinetry, a folding counter, washer and dryer. Additional highlights include an integrated intercom and alarm system, an upgraded water heater, and tandem parking with built-in storage cabinets. Just across the Park Street Bridge, enjoy easy access to Alameda’s vibrant Park Street district with its restaurants, shops, and amenities. The Bay Trail is right outside your front door, while BART, the Alameda and Jack London Square ferry terminals, and Oakland International Airport are all just a short drive away, providing convenient access throughout the Bay Area and beyond.

results.remarks: Push open the big, beautiful gates and the city falls away. What's waiting is a secret garden — the romantic, storybook entry that makes you feel like you've slipped into an English cottage, right in the heart of Temescal.  This home was taken down to the studs and rebuilt. Behind the original double-hung windows and hardwood floors: all-new plumbing, new electrical, and a forced-air furnace. Vintage soul, none of the 3-a.m. surprises.  At 901 square feet, your light-filled upstairs home lives large. New kitchen with stone counters and room to actually cook. Fresh bathroom. Original built-in cabinetry in the formal dining room. A bedroom with a fireplace, built-ins, and a walk-in closet — plus a separate den for the home office or the reading nook. In-unit laundry, so you never hunt for quarters again.  Storage? You win. A private storage locker over 150 sqft with its own entrance — the bikes, the holiday bins, the wine, the someday projects, all of it.   Outside, the common gardens are yours: fire up the grill, gather at the picnic area, wind the evening down by the fire pit. And in a neighborhood this walkable, Temescal's best restaurants and shops are two blocks away.  Charm you can't fake, bones you can count on, in a neighborhood everyone's trying to get into.  Fully remodeled to the studs: new plumbing, electrical, and forced-air heating. New kitchen with stone counters, new bathroom, hardwood floors throughout, original double-hung windows, in-unit laundry, wood-burning fireplace, original built-in cabinetry, walk-in closet, and a flexible den. Private storage locker 150 sqft with separate entrance. Common gardens with grill, picnic area, and fire pit. Walkable Temescal, Oakland location — 2 blocks to restaurants and shopping. 1 bed / 1 bath / 901 sq ft.

results.remarks: Tucked toward the back of Oakland’s Laurel District, this bright two-story townhouse-style condo gives you the best kind of balance: close to the neighborhood, but tucked away enough to feel like you have your own little retreat. With 2 spacious bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and a functional layout that feels more like a home than a typical condo, this one keeps things comfortable, practical, and easy to love.  One of the biggest highlights is the private expanded redwood deck unique to this home within the community. Framed by taller fencing for added privacy, it gives you the kind of outdoor space that is hard to find in a condo or smaller apartment. There is room to lounge, dine, garden, or create a cozy outdoor setup without feeling like you are right on top of everything else. It is the kind of extra space that quietly makes everyday living feel better.  Inside, the main level offers a cozy living room with a fireplace, great natural light, a separate dining area, a space-efficient kitchen, and a convenient half bathroom downstairs, perfect for guests when hosting without sending everyone upstairs into your personal living space. Upstairs, both oversized bedrooms feature generous closets with floor-to-ceiling mirrored doors, adding storage, openness, and a clean modern feel. And for the everyday wins, this home comes with IN-UNIT LAUNDRY, one dedicated carport parking space, plus ample street parking for added convenience.  Located just blocks from local coffee shops, restaurants, shopping, and everyday essentials, this Laurel District location keeps you close to the energy of the neighborhood while still giving you a peaceful place to come home to. With quick access to freeways and public transportation, this home delivers the Bay Area balance everyone is looking for: convenience, comfort, privacy, and a little outdoor space you will actually use.

results.remarks: Fresh opportunity at New Market Lofts in Oakland's Jack London Square! This distinctive Live/Work loft pairs authentic industrial character with the convenience of modern urban living. Originally built as Safeway's corporate headquarters and later converted to loft residences, the historic building remains one of the area's recognizable warehouse-style communities.   Inside, soaring concrete ceilings, exposed architectural details, polished concrete floors and a dramatic wall of windows create a bright, open atmosphere with impressive urban views. The flexible open concept layout provides plenty of room to live, work, entertain or create, while the kitchen with breakfast bar and stainless steel appliances anchors the main living space. Additional conveniences include in-unit laundry, generous storage and secure garage parking.  New Market Lofts offers an established HOA community with resident amenities including a fitness center. Step outside and enjoy the Jack London Square waterfront lifestyle with restaurants, shopping and entertainment nearby, plus convenient access to Amtrak, BART, Oakland/Alameda ferry service and major Bay Area commuter routes.   An exciting opportunity for an owner occupant, creative professional or investor looking for an Oakland loft with architectural character, views and value add potential. Property is offered as-is and may benefit from cosmetic updates/TLC, giving the next owner an opportunity to make the space their own.

results.remarks: Tranquil Ground-Floor Condo in Coveted Shadow Woods Community  Welcome to this beautifully updated ground-floor condo nestled in the peaceful, gated Shadow Woods community — where lush greenery, resort-style amenities, and an unbeatable East Bay location come together in one perfect package.  Step inside to a bright, open-concept living and dining area anchored by a cozy fireplace — ideal for relaxing evenings at home. Fresh interior paint and brand-new luxury vinyl plank flooring flow throughout the main living areas, while plush new carpet in the bedroom adds a warm, inviting feel underfoot. The well-appointed kitchen features gleaming quartz countertops and is fully equipped with a dishwasher and electric stove, making meal prep a pleasure. Step out to your private balcony and take in the serene surroundings — the perfect spot for morning coffee or an evening unwind. Whether you're a first-time buyer stepping into homeownership, downsizing to easier living, or simply seeking a low-maintenance haven in the heart of the East Bay — this is the one you've been waiting for.

results.remarks: They don’t build them like this anymore. This sun-filled, quietly elegant condo—with exclusive-use outdoor space—is set on a beautiful tree-lined block at the crossroads of Rockridge and Elmwood.  Surrounded by grand homes, 6426 Benvenue Ave. #1 reminds you what character actually looks like. Walls of windows fill the living room with natural light, creating a space that feels warm and alive throughout the day. French doors connect the living room and bedroom, allowing the entire home to flow beautifully. An original fireplace, hardwood floors and built-ins add the kind of period detail that gives an older home its soul.  The eat-in kitchen is the kind of place where a slow morning makes sense. Hex tile floors, stainless appliances and a comfortable dining area make it both charming and practical. Community laundry is on site, with a convenient location for a future in-unit washer and dryer, if desired.  But the outdoor space changes the equation entirely. An exclusive-use patio tucked beneath mature redwoods creates a surprisingly peaceful retreat—a place for morning coffee, dinner with friends or simply a quiet afternoon outside. It’s the kind of privacy and calm that’s hard to find just a few blocks from Rockridge BART.  And that’s the magic of this location: you’re in the middle of everything and somehow removed from all of it. Walk to Boichik Bagels, Cole Coffee, Market Hall and the shops, restaurants and cafés of both Rockridge and Elmwood. A dedicated parking space is included, but in a location like this, a car is truly optional.

results.remarks: Tucked away on Oak Grove at College Avenue, this home is a total standout in one of the most sought-after pockets of Rockridge. If you’ve been dreaming of having world-class dining, chic boutiques and easy commute options just around the corner, this is the enviable location you've been waiting for. Inside, the layout is a breath of fresh air. The main floor is designed for effortless flow, where the living room, dining room (complete with charming original built-ins), and the kitchen/family room area all open to one another. It’s the kind of space that naturally encourages people to gather while still offering plenty of room to spread out. The kitchen has been beautifully reimagined with crisp quartz countertops, stainless appliances, and a stylish tile backsplash that ties it all together. You’ll also find a convenient powder room and two large storage closets on this level. The transition to outdoor living is seamless—the family room opens to a massive shared yard that feels like a private sanctuary. Between the lush landscaping, the relaxing hot tub, and the detached garage, there is an incredible amount of space to enjoy. Upstairs, the home continues to impress with three sun-drenched bedrooms. The primary is a true retreat featuring its own fireplace, while the middle bedroom boasts original built-ins perfect for displaying books and treasures. The rear bedroom offers a peaceful view overlooking the garden below. For ultimate convenience, the spacious, recently updated bathroom sits right in the hallway next to the laundry area—exactly where you need it. This is a rare opportunity to own a home that perfectly balances classic Rockridge charm with the modern updates and outdoor space you’ve been searching for.

results.remarks: What happens when a design obsessive spends 14 years turning a live/work loft into something quietly extraordinary? This 1bd/1ba live/work loft at 1018 E 4th Street, Unit 204 is 1,164 sq ft* of considered, layered space, the kind that reveals itself slowly, detail by detail. Hardwood floors, professionally sanded and finished with a custom warm tint, run throughout. Light moves freely, anchored by the piece de resistance: custom Crittall Windows UK "portes-fenêtres style atelier" True Divided Light doors and windows, imported from the UK, that define the bedroom suite while keeping the space open and luminous. The kitchen is a full renovation. Caesarstone countertops, custom cabinetry, a full suite of appliances including a gas cooktop, convection speed oven, and dishwasher, plus Vipp wall shelves and pendant lighting above the dining area, which makes every evening feel intentional. The bathroom followed suit: walk-in shower, floating vanity, Porcelanosa tile, designer lighting by Vipp and Muuto, and a sliding door connecting the bath to the bedroom for seamless flow. A discreet utility closet houses the stacked washer/dryer without giving up an inch of livability. The boiler has recently been upgraded, and the bathroom utility closet reconfigured for additional storage. The bedroom suite itself is a study in thoughtful design, a custom loft frame, a walk-in closet build-out, and those Crittall doors that make the whole thing feel more Parisian atelier than Oakland condo. This is a live/work unit in the truest sense: a calm, design-forward environment to create, collaborate, and come home to. Right in the mix; Jack London Square adjacent, with downtown Oakland, the waterfront, and transit all close at hand. Unit 204 at 1018 E 4th Street isn't just move-in ready. It's move-in and exhale.
